frozen_invariants: Full vacancy text is primary semantic evidence when available.
Rule-based decisions, scores, tiers, reasons and derived keyword hits are prohibited from the pre-evaluation LLM input.
The LLM remains shadow-only and cannot mutate production recommendations.
Rule-based and LLM results are compared only after independent LLM evaluation.
Candidate profile content is versioned separately and is defined in L1.
The contract is model and vendor agnostic.
